instructions.editing: Edit requests. Only enabled requests in enabled provider files run. product_guides contains copyable examples, not downloads. JSON requires double quotes and has no comments.
instructions.identity: id identifies the request; ticker is your label; input contains the provider identifier. Matching requests across providers need the same id, contract/instrument details and timeframe. Use a new id for a different instrument or period.
instructions.timeframe: Use lookback (for example 1mo or 1y) OR start (YYYY-MM-DD), plus end. end=null means today when run; otherwise end is YYYY-MM-DD. The requested range is inclusive. Returned raw responses are not clipped to this range.
instructions.metadata: Set product, operation, currency, unit, asset_class, description, exchange and frequency for the instrument. These fields describe the request; they do not convert the returned data.
instructions.raw_output: run.py saves original provider responses under tests/data_dumps. No local cleaning, resampling or price adjustment is applied; any provider-side adjustments are described below.
instructions.products: The implemented adapter supports stock and etf with operation=price_history and frequency=1d. The disabled SPX option requests are reference examples only; enabling them is rejected.
instructions.input: input.symbol is the Alpha Vantage symbol. Verify its listing and currency using the provider symbol search; do not assume Yahoo suffixes apply.
instructions.parameters: function is TIME_SERIES_DAILY or TIME_SERIES_DAILY_ADJUSTED; outputsize is compact or full. DAILY supplies unadjusted OHLCV; ADJUSTED additionally supplies adjusted close and corporate actions. Full/adjusted access depends on account entitlement.
instructions.history_range: compact returns the latest 100 daily observations, regardless of the requested start/end. This endpoint has no date-range parameters, and raw mode preserves its complete response.
instructions.credentials: run.py reads ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY from the environment. Keep the actual key outside this JSON.

stock_and_etf.instructions: Copy the template into requests, verify the identifier/listing, edit dates, then set enabled=true. ETF input has the same identifier shape but use product=etf.

index_option.instructions: The two disabled SPX requests document the intended contracts. HISTORICAL_OPTIONS requires a per-date adapter that is not implemented here. The last account probe returned a premium-access error; SPX coverage and provider identifiers remain unverified. A subscription alone does not enable these requests in this library.
